subtitles.zh: 食源性疾病双重打击考验消费者信任。
subtitles.en: A double whammy of food-borne illness is putting consumer trust to the test.

subtitles.zh: 与生菜相关的环孢子虫寄生虫爆发，加上与墨西哥辣椒相关的沙门氏菌。
subtitles.en: An outbreak of the parasitic pathogen, Cyclospora, tied to raw lettuce, plus a salmonella flera tied to jalapenos.

subtitles.zh: 这给餐馆和食品品牌带来压力。
subtitles.en: It's putting restaurants and food brands under pressure.

subtitles.zh: 环孢子虫对我们的业务造成了影响，就像对任何销售新鲜农产品的人一样。
subtitles.en: Cyclospora has had an impact on our business as it has had a business, had an impact on really anyone selling fresh produce.

subtitles.zh: 我们希望谨慎对待指引，并考虑到我们注意到的食品安全问题的一些更广泛担忧的影响。
subtitles.en: We want to be prudent with our guidance and take into account what we noted to be the impact of some of the broader concerns around food safety issues.

subtitles.zh: 通常，当消费者消化这些信息时，他们会少吃一点绿叶蔬菜。
subtitles.en: Usually for our eating a little bit less greens as they sort of process the information that's been happening.

subtitles.zh: 但不久前，一些CEO听起来并不那么担忧。
subtitles.en: But it wasn't too long ago that some CEOs didn't sound so concerned.

subtitles.zh: 我们完全不受影响，我认为客户理解供应链运转非常快。产品可能已经离开供应链，一切正常。
subtitles.en: We're not affected at all and I think customers understand that the supply chain moves very quickly. The product is probably out of the supply chain and everything's fine.

subtitles.zh: 我们已与合作伙伴检查了供应链中的成分，以了解是否有任何成分与环孢子虫爆发有关。
subtitles.en: We have gone through our supply chain ingredients with our partners to understand if any of our ingredients have been indicated in the cyclospora outbreak

subtitles.zh: 目前没有，我们预计也不会有。
subtitles.en: and they haven't today. We don't expect that they will.

subtitles.zh: 但现在食品安全问题，已经大到无法忽视。
subtitles.en: But now food safety concerns, they're just too big to ignore.

subtitles.zh: Placer.ai是一家客流量分析公司，数据显示一些主要快餐连锁店的客流量下降，包括塔可钟，CDC将部分环孢子虫疫情追溯到该店。
subtitles.en: Placer.ai, a foot traffic analytics firm, says visits are down at some major fast food chains, including Taco Bell, where the CDC traced part of the cyclospora outbreak.

subtitles.zh: 关键在于沟通。当消费者对疫情原因及应对措施缺乏信心时，问题就变得棘手。
subtitles.en: It's all about communication. When consumers don't have confidence in what happened to cause the outbreak, what solutions were put in place to make it happen. That makes it very difficult.
